It asserted a hit ten pixels ABOVE the top of the drawing and never touched the band that was broken. Mechanical beats prose only if the mechanism reads the SOURCE OF TRUTH - here, the line that positions the sprite. Derive test geometry from the placement function, never from the comment describing it.
